name: Csömödér (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, green at the hoist and white at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Csömödér (a green and white shield with a sheaf of grain) below a yellow scroll inscribed CSÖMÖDÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
